name: com.aurix.voice
description: Game voice client for the Aurix Voice Platform: native AURX media (QUIC/UDP/WebSocket tunnel) with the WebSocket control plane on desktop, mobile and .NET servers, and the same IAurixVoiceClient API over browser WebRTC in Unity WebGL players. Opus, E2EE, per-participant spatial audio, chat, transcripts, TTS, quality stats.

samples.description: IOpusCodec implementation using the pure-C# Concentus library (add the Concentus 2.x netstandard2.0 assembly to Assets/Plugins).

Scene + MonoBehaviour for desktop/mobile players: connect with a player token, join a channel, roster with speaking/energy, mute and push-to-talk, network quality bars and client stats, reconnect, chat. Requires the Concentus sample (or the native core).

Scene + MonoBehaviour for Unity WebGL players: the same lobby over AurixWebGLVoiceBehaviour (browser WebRTC through aurix-web-sdk.js), reads ws/api/token/channel from the page URL, autoplay unlock button. Includes a WebGL template that ships the Web SDK bundle.
